verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a GitHub importer that brings over repositories with their issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, with optional one-way or two-way sync. It also offers branch mirroring with another Git server. However, migration tooling appears limited to GitHub, and branch-level mirroring is not a full migration path. Missing for 10: importers for other platforms (e.g. GitLab, Bitbucket) or self-hosted instances, explicit migration of users or organizations and their permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
